title: What's new in v2.7.2
summary: See the current readings in Monitoring right next to min/max/mean.

steps.title: Monitoring stats tables
steps.listLabel: See the current reading for device / modem stats
steps.body: Every stats table in Monitoring now has the **Latest** value shown for every stat. The **Latest** column is tinted to break up the columns in the stats table for easier scanning.
